description: This file defines the 'Affiliate' model class for the Opencart admin module, providing CRUD operations and data retrieval methods for customer affiliate records. It encapsulates database interactions related to affliate management, including adding, editing, deleting affiliates and their reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Model class for managing customer affiliate data within Opencart's admin marketing module, including create, read, update, delete, and reporting functionalities.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new customer affiliate record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing customer affiliate record identified by customer ID with the provided data.

methods.name: editBalance
methods.description: Updates the balance of the customer affiliate identified by customer ID.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Removes the customer affiliate record and associated reports from the database.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves affiliate data for a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate data using a tracking string.

methods.name: getAffiliates
methods.description: Fetches a list of affiliate records, optionally filtered and sorted.

methods.name: getTotalAffiliates
methods.description: Returns the total count of affiliate records matching optional filters.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Gets reports associated with a specific affiliate/customer ID.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports related to a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns total number of reports for a specific customer ID.
